description: This file is a PHP template for rendering an admin interface related to promoting items within nodes or channels. It includes HTML markup, PHP logic for dynamic content, and JavaScript for client-side interactions such as toggling UI elements and making AJAX requests.

methods.name: goChannelPromote
methods.description: Navigates to a different channel promote page based on the selected node.

methods.name: send_promote
methods.description: Sends an AJAX POST request to promote a selected item via the API.

methods.name: toggle_typeahead
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the typeahead promotion input section.
